macros.name: attribute
macros.doc: \attribute{text} Applies the **Attribute** color (Price, Kcal, etc.) and monospaced font.

macros.name: constraint
macros.doc: Applies monospaced font for entire constraint expressions.

macros.name: feature
macros.doc: \feature{text} Applies the **Feature** color (Pizza, Topping, etc.) and monospaced font.

macros.name: inputuvl
macros.doc: This command imports an external .uvl file and formats it as a UVL code block. It accepts optional arguments compatible with lstinputlisting.
